failed_assertion: every post-submit Thinking sample must be owned by the new prompt's user message; sampled Thinking rows carried ses_core_busy_abort_errors_prev instead
passed_assertions: Thinking did eventually anchor to the new prompt's messageID once the new assistant envelope arrived
follow-up reply ack 1: Thinking ownership probe rendered
mechanism: The previous turn's assistant envelope lacks time.completed (reply parts painted, completion envelope still in flight) while the session reports busy. activeMessageID resolves pending() -> the stale assistant -> its parentID = the OLD user message, so the old turn stays isActive + unsettled and emits the Thinking row inside its own block — beneath the completed-looking reply and ABOVE the newly sent prompt bubbles. When the new turn's message.updated(pending) lands, pending() re-resolves to it and Thinking relocates.
visual_scope: Per-frame DOM sampling attributes each painted Thinking row to a data-message-id; post-submit frames carried the previous turn's id while the new user bubble was rendered below it. Failure screenshot, video, and trace retained.
